title: Global Preferences
description: Configure global settings for your BookLib instance, including cover image handling, search preferences, and file upload limits.

covers.regenerateDesc: Regenerates cover images for all books from the embedded covers in the file. Use "Regenerate Missing" to only generate covers for books that don't have one yet.
covers.verticalCroppingDesc: Automatically crop extremely tall images (like web comics) from the top to create usable cover thumbnails.
covers.horizontalCroppingDesc: Automatically crop extremely wide images from the left to create usable cover thumbnails.
covers.aspectRatioDesc: Images with aspect ratios exceeding this threshold will be cropped. A value of 2.5 means images more than 2.5x taller (or wider) than normal will be cropped.
covers.smartCroppingDesc: Skip uniform colour regions when determining where to crop. Focuses the cover image on the most relevant content.

search.autoBookSearchDesc: Automatically attempts metadata matching when the book information panel is opened.
search.similarBookDesc: Enables or disables similar book recommendations based on your library.

recommendations.embeddingDesc: Configure the Ollama model used to generate multilingual book embeddings.
recommendations.backfillWarning: Changing the model creates a new staged index. Run Update Book Recommendations to backfill it; the current model remains active until the backfill completes.
recommendations.modelsError: Could not load models from Ollama. Check the URL and server availability.
recommendations.invalidDetail: Enter an Ollama URL, a model name, and a batch size between 1 and 256.

smartEnrichment.enabledDesc: Lets an installed agent CLI identify the work behind a file and suggest metadata. Ratings are still fetched by the provider parsers, never taken from the agent.
smartEnrichment.notInstalled: Agent CLI not found on this instance. Install it on the server to use this feature.
smartEnrichment.notAuthenticated: Not signed in. Run the agent CLI once in a terminal on the server to authorise it.
smartEnrichment.deepSearchDesc: Off (default): the agent answers from its own knowledge only — fast and cheap, but no fetched descriptions. On: it searches the web and reads pages to confirm the edition and quote a real description — accurate, but slow and uses far more quota.
smartEnrichment.testError: The agent test could not be completed.

fileManagement.maxUploadDesc: Defines the maximum allowed size (in MB) for each uploaded file. Applies to all supported file formats.
fileManagement.restartWarning: Changes will take effect after restarting the server
fileManagement.invalidInputDetail: Please enter a valid max file upload size in MB.

settingsError: There was an error saving the settings.
